prompt: Run a doc audit on this project

assertions.description: Does not report valid links as broken (all links in clean-project are valid)
assertions.check: report does not claim any links are broken

assertions.description: Does not invent stale content claims for content that is accurate
assertions.check: report does not claim content is stale/outdated when it is actually correct

assertions.description: Total issues reported is 3 or fewer (clean project should not generate many findings)
assertions.check: count total distinct issues in report, should be <= 3

assertions.description: Zero critical issues reported (nothing in clean-project warrants critical severity)
